title: UI/UX Renaissance & Premium Design System
summary: All 5 tasks complete: Premium Design System, Consumer Bottom Tab Bar + Framer Motion, Discovery Feed Redesign, Vendor KDS Redesign, Tests.

tasks.name: Premium Design System
tasks.details: Extended snakZapPreset with typography scale, spacing grid, 5-level shadow system, 4-stop borderRadius, urgency colors (Green/Amber/Red), 9 keyframe animations. Created 7 new UI components: Button (4 variants, 3 sizes), Card (glass morphism, hoverable), BottomNav (persistent tab bar), ActiveOrderBar (live order status), Sheet (bottom sheet with backdrop), Badge (8 variants), CountdownTimer (live KDS countdown).

tasks.name: Consumer Navigation
tasks.details: ClientProviders wraps children in LazyMotion+domAnimation for tree-shaking. Persistent 4-tab BottomNav (Home/Orders/Cart/Profile) with cart badge from Zustand store. Active path highlighting with activeHref prop. Scrollbar-hide and safe-area-bottom CSS utilities added.

tasks.name: Discovery Feed Redesign
tasks.details: RestaurantCard redesigned: thumbnail + Open/Closed badge (pulse animation), Queue status chip, ~15min prep time, Quick Add button triggers Sheet with top 5 menu items and one-tap add-to-cart. TrendingCarousel with gold/silver/bronze rank Badges, motion staggered entry, 'X sold' social proof. PersonalizedFeed updated with dark mode, Badge component, motion animations.

tasks.name: Vendor KDS Redesign
tasks.details: 4-column Kanban: New Orders, Preparing, Almost Ready, Ready for Pickup. Urgency color-coded (Green<30%, Amber 30-70%, Red>70%) on left border accent + background tint. CountdownTimer on each card with live seconds. AnimatePresence for order transitions. Dark-native full-height (h-dvh), real-time clock, WebSocket indicator. VendorLayoutClient conditionally hides VendorNav on dashboard only.

tasks.name: Tests
tasks.details: 25 new React Testing Library tests: BottomNav (10 tests - render, hrefs, active state, badges, onNavigate), Sheet (6 tests - open/close, backdrop click, title, overflow), CountdownTimer (9 tests - countdown, MM:SS format, zero stop, green/amber/red thresholds, onExpire callback).
